## 1. Intake
Three doors, one item shape:
- **Gmail**: new email with a PDF attachment (one item per PDF). An email whose Gmail ID is already in p3_processing_log is skipped, so no email is processed twice.
- **Eval Runner**: a test file from Drive `test-set`
- **Dev**: 3 test files, for building only

## Config
Model, prompt version, cost categories and stores. The eval records the model and prompt version of every run.

## 2. Read the invoice
The AI reads the PDF itself (text PDFs and scans alike) and copies what is printed into a locked JSON format. It never calculates or corrects: code checks the numbers in stage 4.
`Read Path` notes whether the PDF has a text layer or is an image, for the log and the eval.

## 4–5. Check, allocate, route
Code recalculates every number the AI read and turns each problem into a reason code. `allocate.js` picks the store of every line by rule; the category the AI chose is checked against the list.
Duplicate = same supplier + same invoice number. Emails are compared with Airtable (one search per email), test files with the earlier files of the same eval run.
Test files stop at `Eval Run?` and go back to the Eval Runner.

## 6. Record (emails only)
Recorded and needs-review invoices: the QuickBooks vendor is matched by name (never created), then the PDF goes to Drive `Invoices`, then one Airtable Invoice record (status, review reasons, problem statement, PDF link) and its Line Items with store and category. No vendor match = needs review. Creating records is never retried, so nothing is recorded twice.

parameters.name: query
parameters.value: select Id, DisplayName, CompanyName from Vendor where Active = true maxresults 1000

parameters.content:
## 6b. QuickBooks bill (recorded only)
One unpaid bill per recorded invoice: a bill line per invoice line (account from the category, Class from the store) plus a tax line. The bill ID goes back to Airtable, and the code checks the QuickBooks total. Then the PDF is attached to the bill. Bills and attachments are never retried; a failed attachment is listed for stage 7 instead of stopping the run.

## 7a. Tell the team: skipped
Duplicates and documents that are not invoices get a short note in #invoice-review, so nothing disappears silently. Errors are reported in stage 7b.

## 7a. Tell the team: needs review
One message per needs-review invoice in #invoice-review: the same problem statement as in Airtable (problem, why it was flagged, what to check) with links to the PDF and the record. Recorded invoices send nothing.

## 7b. Log and alert: not recorded
Every duplicate, non-invoice and failed document gets a row in p3_processing_log. A failed reading also goes to #automation-errors: what failed, the impact, what is saved, and what to do next.

## 7b. Log: needs review
One row in p3_processing_log per needs-review invoice, with its Airtable record and Drive link.

## 7b. Log and alert: recorded
One row in p3_processing_log per recorded invoice, with its QuickBooks bill. A PDF that did not reach its bill goes to #automation-errors.
